principle: A pattern candidate is a queue item for stronger models, not a conclusion.

cohorts.cohort_policy: Pulotu cultural-tradition profiles using explicit PRESENT mappings only.

null_model.test: one-sided hypergeometric enrichment with fixed feature marginals
null_model.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the complete eligible independent feature-pair testing universe within cohort, before display filtering
null_model.mapping_dependence_guard: Feature pairs sharing an upstream question/variable anywhere in the cohort, plus identical normalized facets across dimensions, are excluded from testing.
null_model.interpretation: Screens for surprising co-occurrence under naive fixed marginals only. It is not a causal, ancestral, diffusion, phylogenetic, spatial, or full source-independence test.
